_readme: Single source of truth for the Publications section AND the hero article counter. Edit THIS file, never the generated HTML. Rebuild: python3 scripts/build_publications.py (also runs in CI on push). status: published | in_press (requires accepted_date) | under_review (requires since = submission date; journal NOT listed publicly) | revise_resubmit (requires journal + since = decision date). Working papers are auto-ordered R&R -> under review -> other, newest first. The build lints stale statuses. Research themes: `themes` (id/title/blurb) drives the Research section cards; every entry carries `themes: [ids]` (lint: non-empty, known ids), the build counts articles and working papers per theme and tags each pub-item with data-themes for the on-page filter.

themes.title: Financial Regulation & Insurance Supervision
themes.blurb: How prudential rules measure what they regulate: Solvency II long-term-guarantee and transitional measures, IAS 40 versus Solvency II valuation, catastrophe-loss disclosure, the EU Single Rulebook Q&A process, crypto-asset disclosure under MiCA, and the legal perimeter of event contracts.

themes.title: Digital & Knowledge Economy, Innovation & IP
themes.blurb: Measuring the digital economy in sectoral value added (Journal of Policy Modeling, 2026), knowledge processes and value creation (Journal of the Knowledge Economy, forthcoming), trademark and design renewals as revealed private value, science–technology relatedness, home bias in knowledge flows, and AI naming in venture funding.

themes.title: Tourism, Climate & Destination Risk
themes.blurb: Marine bioinvasion and the Mediterranean tourism economy (Current Issues in Tourism, 2026), downside risk in a destination's source-market portfolio, validating heatwave treatments for tourism demand, cash infrastructure and visitor flows, inbound tourism during war, and whether tourism regions can staff their future.

themes.title: Financial Markets & Computational Finance
themes.blurb: Equity-market closures and cryptocurrency volatility (International Review of Economics and Finance, 2026), geopolitical risk beyond the VIX, defence-equity repricing, co-jumps in commodity futures as inflation signals, sovereign early repayment, and unsupervised machine learning in financial time series.

themes.title: Regional, Sectoral & Structural Change
themes.blurb: Recovery regimes after crises: sectoral reallocation, structural selection and post-crisis performance in Europe (Review of Economic Analysis, forthcoming), battery-electric penetration and the car-repair aftermarket, skills pathways in just-transition regions, the stability of comparative advantage, and spatial determinants of entrepreneurship in Greek regions.

themes.title: EU Public Finance & Economic Measurement
themes.blurb: Spectrum rent in national accounts and EU own resources, the 1898 International Financial Commission pledge, VAT differentials and art-market gateways, electric-vehicle subsidy design, measurement degrees of freedom in composite indices, and earlier work on the shadow economy, competitiveness and the taxation of nations.

themes.title: Population, Health & Labour
themes.blurb: Migration and pension adequacy, asylum corridors and gravity, caesarean-birth dynamics in ten low- and middle-income countries, parental co-residence in university cities, long-hours tails and work–family strain, and generational renewal in European farming.

themes.title: Econometric Methodology
themes.blurb: Spurious regression and serial correlation for independent stationary AR(1) processes, the size–power balance in tests of association, estimator dependence in panel and state-dependence settings, and measurement-first identification across the applied work above.
